text.p: Forekspank's board decided to raise its profit forecast for 1997 by 18.6 million kroons to 90.4 million kroons, the bank said on Wednesday.
The new profit forecast is based on the expectation of the bank's development remaining at the same tempo as before, the bank said in a statement.
The bank expects that its income will be no less that 258 million kroons and spending will not exceed 136 million kroons in 1997.
In preparing the new forecast, the bank took into consideration the increasing competition in the banking sector and falling interest rates, the bank said.
The bank also forecast that by the end of 1997 the balance sheet volume of the bank will be 2.6 billion kroons and the bank will hold eight percent of the market.
Forekspank group profit estimate for 1997 will be released in August.
